verses.en: Though I speak with the tongues of men and of angels, and have not charity, I am become as sounding brass, or a tinkling cymbal.
verses.pt: Ainda que eu falasse as línguas dos homens e dos anjos, e não tivesse amor, seria como o metal que soa ou como o címbalo que retine.
verses.en_web: If I speak with the languages of men and of angels, but don’t have love, I have become sounding brass, or a clanging cymbal.
verses.en_bbe: If I make use of the tongues of men and of angels, and have not love, I am like sounding brass, or a loud-tongued bell.

verses.en: And though I have the gift of prophecy, and understand all mysteries, and all knowledge; and though I have all faith, so that I could remove mountains, and have not charity, I am nothing.
verses.pt: E ainda que tivesse o dom de profecia, e conhecesse todos os mistérios e toda a ciência, e ainda que tivesse toda fé, de maneira tal que transportasse os montes, e não tivesse amor, nada seria.
verses.en_web: If I have the gift of prophecy, and know all mysteries and all knowledge; and if I have all faith, so as to remove mountains, but don’t have love, I am nothing.
verses.en_bbe: And if I have a prophet's power, and have knowledge of all secret things; and if I have all faith, by which mountains may be moved from their place, but have not love, I am nothing.

verses.en: And though I bestow all my goods to feed the poor, and though I give my body to be burned, and have not charity, it profiteth me nothing.
verses.pt: E ainda que distribuísse todos os meus bens para sustento dos pobres, e ainda que entregasse o meu corpo para ser queimado, e não tivesse amor, nada disso me aproveitaria.
verses.en_web: If I give away all my goods to feed the poor, and if I give my body to be burned, but don’t have love, it profits me nothing.
verses.en_bbe: And if I give all my goods to the poor, and if I give my body to be burned, but have not love, it is of no profit to me.

verses.en: Charity suffereth long, and is kind; charity envieth not; charity vaunteth not itself, is not puffed up,
verses.pt: O amor é sofredor, é benigno; o amor não é invejoso; o amor não se vangloria, não se ensoberbece,
verses.en_web: Love is patient and is kind; love doesn’t envy. Love doesn’t brag, is not proud,
verses.en_bbe: Love is never tired of waiting; love is kind; love has no envy; love has no high opinion of itself, love has no pride;

verses.en: Doth not behave itself unseemly, seeketh not her own, is not easily provoked, thinketh no evil;
verses.pt: não se porta inconvenientemente, não busca os seus próprios interesses, não se irrita, não suspeita mal;
verses.en_web: doesn’t behave itself inappropriately, doesn’t seek its own way, is not provoked, takes no account of evil;
verses.en_bbe: Love's ways are ever fair, it takes no thought for itself; it is not quickly made angry, it takes no account of evil;

verses.en: Rejoiceth not in iniquity, but rejoiceth in the truth;
verses.pt: não se regozija com a injustiça, mas se regozija com a verdade;
verses.en_web: doesn’t rejoice in unrighteousness, but rejoices with the truth;
verses.en_bbe: It takes no pleasure in wrongdoing, but has joy in what is true;

verses.en: Beareth all things, believeth all things, hopeth all things, endureth all things.
verses.pt: tudo sofre, tudo crê, tudo espera, tudo suporta.
verses.en_web: bears all things, believes all things, hopes all things, endures all things.
verses.en_bbe: Love has the power of undergoing all things, having faith in all things, hoping all things.

verses.en: Charity never faileth: but whether there be prophecies, they shall fail; whether there be tongues, they shall cease; whether there be knowledge, it shall vanish away.
verses.pt: O amor jamais acaba; mas havendo profecias, serão aniquiladas; havendo línguas, cessarão; havendo ciência, desaparecerá;
verses.en_web: Love never fails. But where there are prophecies, they will be done away with. Where there are various languages, they will cease. Where there is knowledge, it will be done away with.
verses.en_bbe: Though the prophet's word may come to an end, tongues come to nothing, and knowledge have no more value, love has no end.

verses.en: For we know in part, and we prophesy in part.
verses.pt: porque, em parte conhecemos, e em parte profetizamos;
verses.en_web: For we know in part, and we prophesy in part;
verses.en_bbe: For our knowledge is only in part, and the prophet's word gives only a part of what is true:

verses.en: But when that which is perfect is come, then that which is in part shall be done away.
verses.pt: mas, quando vier o que é perfeito, então o que é em parte será aniquilado.
verses.en_web: but when that which is complete has come, then that which is partial will be done away with.
verses.en_bbe: But when that which is complete is come, then that which is in part will be no longer necessary.

verses.en: When I was a child, I spake as a child, I understood as a child, I thought as a child: but when I became a man, I put away childish things.
verses.pt: Quando eu era menino, pensava como menino; mas, logo que cheguei a ser homem, acabei com as coisas de menino.
verses.en_web: When I was a child, I spoke as a child, I felt as a child, I thought as a child. Now that I have become a man, I have put away childish things.
verses.en_bbe: When I was a child, I made use of a child's language, I had a child's feelings and a child's thoughts: now that I am a man, I have put away the things of a child.

verses.en: For now we see through a glass, darkly; but then face to face: now I know in part; but then shall I know even as also I am known.
verses.pt: Porque agora vemos como por espelho, em enigma, mas então veremos face a face; agora conheço em parte, mas então conhecerei plenamente, como também sou plenamente conhecido.
verses.en_web: For now we see in a mirror, dimly, but then face to face. Now I know in part, but then I will know fully, even as I was also fully known.
verses.en_bbe: For now we see things in a glass, darkly; but then face to face: now my knowledge is in part; then it will be complete, even as God's knowledge of me.

verses.en: And now abideth faith, hope, charity, these three; but the greatest of these is charity.
verses.pt: Agora, pois, permanecem a fé, a esperança, o amor, estes três; mas o maior destes é o amor.
verses.en_web: But now faith, hope, and love remain—these three. The greatest of these is love.
verses.en_bbe: But now we still have faith, hope, love, these three; and the greatest of these is love.
